name: Brodo
description: Manufacturer of men's fashion and footwear products intended to provide stylish, well-made, and affordable footwear. The company offers a wide range of products, from formal and casual shoes, as well as sneakers and boots, enabling buyers to get better quality shoes from both online and retail stores.

name: P5M Project Management
description: Developer of fitness application software designed for health and fitness training. The company's application provides various training routines and diet advice for its users, regarding weight loss, weight training, and strength training, enabling customers to access training from certified trainers easily.

name: Coded
description: Provider of boot camp program services intended to offer coding technology for building a tech startup. The company's program requires basic computer science background having a course curriculum in Python, web designing, Django, java, and software project management that are designed by industry experts and qualified instructors, enabling students and professionals to deploy applications into a production environment easily and prepare for a demanding job market.

name: GymNadz
description: Developer of a fitness application designed to help users get in shape, eat clean and stay on track. The company's application offers short real-time workouts that require very little equipment, clean easy-to-make recipes, and the guidance of a fitness professional, enabling women to monitor their progress and achieve specific fitness goals.

name: Myu
description: Developer of a communication platform designed to facilitate proper communication with the school community. The company's application lets users communicate with their students by sending announcements and notifications to any mobile at any time along with attaching photos and voice notifications, enabling teachers to connect with the community without the need of sharing a phone number.
